services.value: Provides environmental laboratory testing for organic and inorganic analysis of various matrices, including analytical capabilities such as Volatile/Semivolatile Organics by GC/MS, PCBs by GC, petroleum hydrocarbons by GC, metals by ICP/MS & ICP, and mercury by Cold Vapor Technique. Also provides field services (e.g., soil/sediment, groundwater, wastewater/surface water, air sampling) and construction support including waste disposal, waste management, and health and safety services.
